modules.name: road_yolo_numeric_rom_group
modules.description: Four 40-bit PH1P_LOGIC_ERAM lanes form one 160-bit by 512-word physical ROM group.

ports.name: i_word_addr
ports.description: Common word address for all four lanes

ports.name: o_word_data
ports.description: Twenty package bytes in increasing byte order

behavior: All four single-port logical ERAM instances read the same address on i_clk.
Two 80-bit pair registers followed by one 160-bit register limit every data merge to two sources.
The output order is delta, gamma, beta, alpha so package byte zero is o_word_data[7:0].
constraints: Use the documented PH1P_LOGIC_ERAM logical wrapper in SP mode with width 40, depth 512, and IMPLEMENT 20K.
Do not name PDP20K as the logical MODE; the vendor wrapper performs the internal physical mapping.
corner_cases: Address zero and address 511 must be readable without aliasing.
verification_cases: Compare all 512 output words against the four lane initialization files.

timing_diagrams.title: Synchronous physical group read
timing_diagrams.description: The primitive samples a common word address and returns the corresponding four-lane word.

modules.name: road_yolo_numeric_rom_probe
modules.description: Narrow-I/O self-starting CRC32 probe that observes all 143360 bytes in fourteen ROM groups.

ports.name: o_checksum
ports.description: Final reflected IEEE CRC32 of the padded package

behavior: The first clock after reset release starts at group zero, word zero, bit zero without a start pin.
Each selected 160-bit word is captured after the primitive, two-stage group assembly, and four-stage registered group mux latency.
Each package bit uses one fetch cycle and one reflected IEEE CRC32 update cycle; this keeps the selected bit and feedback logic in separate registered cones.
After group thirteen word 511 bit 159, o_checksum receives the final XOR value and o_done remains asserted until reset.
constraints: Instantiate exactly fourteen road_yolo_numeric_rom_group modules and select each group during the runtime scan.
Only clock, reset, done, and checksum cross the top-level boundary to stay well below the device I/O budget.
Every address and every bit must influence the externally visible checksum to prevent content trimming.
The registered group selection tree merges at most two data sources per stage.
A fifteen-state one-hot controller separates read latency, capture, bit processing, address advance, and completion tasks.
corner_cases: Reset during scanning restarts from the first byte and clears done.
The final 2838 zero-padding bytes are included in the checksum.
Completion is sticky and the checksum is stable until reset.
verification_cases: Compare every captured 160-bit word, including group and word boundaries, with the padded golden package.
Check the final checksum against a testbench computation over all 143360 bytes.
Run long enough to prove all fourteen times 512 words are scanned.

timing_diagrams.title: Autonomous full-package checksum scan
timing_diagrams.description: The probe issues reads, folds twenty bytes per word, advances all groups, then latches done and checksum.

modules.name: PH1P_LOGIC_ERAM
modules.description: Icarus-only behavioral stand-in for the vendor logical ERAM wrapper.
behavior: Load INIT_FILE with readmemh and model the enabled port-A synchronous read used by the probe.
constraints: This file is testbench-only and is not vendor synthesis evidence.
corner_cases: Unused vendor-compatible port-B and ECC signals remain deterministic.
verification_cases: Compile the production RTL under Icarus without the encrypted vendor model.

timing_diagrams.title: Behavioral stub read
timing_diagrams.description: An enabled rising edge updates doa from the selected memory address.

modules.name: tb_road_yolo_numeric_rom_probe
behavior: Load the 7168-word golden image, compare every captured word, and independently calculate the final CRC32.
constraints: Use a watchdog and fail on the first address, data, count, done, or checksum mismatch.
corner_cases: Explicitly record checks at words zero, 511, 512, 7025, 7026, and 7167 to cover group boundaries and the payload-to-padding transition.
verification_cases: Require exactly 7168 full-word comparisons and a matching final checksum.

timing_diagrams.title: Full-package self-check
timing_diagrams.description: The testbench observes internal captured words while the public interface remains narrow.
